description: Reopen r-sort-3b-lu (English UK, LANGID 0x0809) read-only. Reads (a.ID, b.ID) of a self-join where a.K < b.K over the first 24 pair-corpus IDs on T and on T0; where a.ID < b.ID and a.K = b.K over all IDs on T and on T0; and (a.ID, b.ID, StrComp(a.K, b.K, m)) for m = 0, 1 and 2 over the first 16 IDs with a.ID < b.ID. Asks whether the < and = relations, the text and database modes of StrComp, and the index-ordered sequences are mutually consistent under this locale, with and without an index.
retentionNote: Designed r-sort-3b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
